key_reasoning.reason: Two hand-written DTO records (PetDto, VisitDto), a new InvalidDtoException, ExceptionControllerAdvice handling, PetRestControllerV1 and the openapi-generator schemaMappings config in pom.xml; shared exception advice touches all REST controllers.

No exact precedent: compact-constructor validation that must surface as HTTP 400 when Jackson deserializes requests (wrapped in HttpMessageNotReadableException) but as 500 when thrown while mapping stored data to responses. Error-message echoing is limited to InvalidDtoException to avoid leaking parser internals. Constraints are duplicated between openapi.yml and record constants, needing a new drift test; enumerated edge/boundary cases needed new parameterized-style tests (PetDtoTests, VisitDtoTests).
13 files per diffstat (669 insertions, 95 deletions): 6 main files and 7 test files including 3 new test classes and a new exception class.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk held at L: validation and error-handling semantics (400 vs 500) with no exact existing precedent and input-validation security surface
Technical Risk: enumerated edge/boundary cases with no pre-existing test template, so new defensive tests were required
